promptEs: En Fa♯ mayor, ¿en qué grado resuelve V/V?
promptEn: In F♯ major, which degree does V/V resolve to?
explanationEs: En Fa♯ mayor, V/V es Sol♯7 y resuelve en Do♯ (V). Su tercera es la sensible de Do♯ y sube un semitono al resolver.
explanationEn: In F♯ major, V/V is G♯7 and it resolves to C♯ (V). Its third is the leading tone of C♯ and rises a semitone when it resolves.
